enrichment.summary: The Board adopts the Measure N Commission's recommendation to fund Ralph J. Bunche Academy for the 2022-23 school year, up to $103,427.16. Measure N pays for college and career readiness programs. The school is in its second year of probationary status under the program, with full funding. The attached memo lists $103,427.16 as the allocation; it is not simply $850 x 77 pupils, since the memo says Alternative Education schools are funded on prior-year attendance.

items.group: Measure N Commission - January 4, 2022 - Jason Gumataotao, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission
items.sourceIssue: The text gives $850.00 x 77 pupils, which equals $65,450, but states an amount not to exceed $103,427.16; the attached funding memo lists $103,427.16 as the allocation and says Alternative Education schools are funded on prior-year attendance, but does not show the calculation.

enrichment.headline: Awards Western Roofing Service $181,963 to replace the roof at the 900 High Street site
enrichment.summary: Roofing Constructors, Inc., doing business as Western Roofing Service, would remove and replace the existing roofing for the 900 High Street Roofing Replacement Project. The $181,963 price includes a $15,000 contingency, and the company was the lowest responsible, responsive bidder. Work is expected to start February 10, 2022 and end May 11, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Hires Jensen Hughes for up to $123,660 of fire and alarm engineering at Roosevelt Middle School
enrichment.summary: Jensen Hughes, Inc. would provide fire and alarm engineering and observation services, including independent peer review and supervision of construction, for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. The not-to-exceed amount of $123,660 includes a $10,560 contingency. Work is scheduled from February 10, 2022 to February 9, 2027, the length of the project.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
